note: Roster checked against the text of the 12 course lectures (names found in each lecture). The PDFs are not in this repository; #51-#53 add anyone a script names.

scientists.name: Blaise Pascal
scientists.contribution: With Fermat, founded probability in the 1654 letters on games of chance.

scientists.name: Pierre de Fermat
scientists.contribution: Pascal's correspondent; counted outcomes of interrupted games.

scientists.name: Isaac Newton
scientists.contribution: The binomial theorem behind the binomial coefficients.

scientists.name: Jacob Bernoulli
scientists.contribution: Bernoulli scheme and the first law of large numbers.

scientists.name: Abraham de Moivre
scientists.contribution: Normal approximation to the binomial law.

scientists.name: Pierre-Simon Laplace
scientists.contribution: Classical probability and the integral limit theorem.

scientists.name: Carl Friedrich Gauss
scientists.contribution: The normal law and its bell curve.

scientists.name: Siméon Denis Poisson
scientists.contribution: Law of rare events and his law of large numbers.

scientists.name: Thomas Bayes
scientists.contribution: Inverse probability: posterior from prior and likelihood.

scientists.name: Georges-Louis Leclerc de Buffon
scientists.contribution: Coin-toss runs and the needle problem.

scientists.name: Joseph Bertrand
scientists.contribution: The chord paradox: 'random' needs a stated scheme.

scientists.name: Sergei Bernstein
scientists.contribution: Pairwise but not mutual independence example.

scientists.name: Pafnuty Chebyshev
scientists.contribution: Chebyshev inequality and law of large numbers.

scientists.name: Andrey Markov
scientists.contribution: Markov inequality and his form of the law of large numbers.

scientists.name: Aleksandr Lyapunov
scientists.contribution: Central limit theorem under the Lyapunov condition.

scientists.name: Aleksandr Khinchin
scientists.contribution: Law of large numbers without finite variance.

scientists.name: Andrey Kolmogorov
scientists.contribution: Axioms of probability and the goodness-of-fit test.

scientists.name: Jarl Waldemar Lindeberg
scientists.contribution: Central limit theorem for i.i.d. sums (with Lévy).

scientists.name: Paul Lévy
scientists.contribution: Central limit theorem for i.i.d. sums (with Lindeberg).

scientists.name: Augustin-Louis Cauchy
scientists.contribution: A law whose running means never settle.

scientists.name: Karl Pearson
scientists.contribution: The χ² goodness-of-fit test; long coin-toss runs.

scientists.name: Valery Glivenko
scientists.contribution: The empirical distribution function converges to the true one.

scientists.name: William Sealy Gosset (Student)
scientists.contribution: The t distribution for small samples.

scientists.name: Ronald Fisher
scientists.contribution: The F distribution for comparing variances (with Snedecor).

scientists.name: George W. Snedecor
scientists.contribution: Tabulated and named the F distribution (with Fisher).
